items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When he got to me he said, “I can get you a job in one of the small clubs... So I didn‟t get the $300 but I got the job.

ctx.x: At this time he had a manager named Sam Scholnick. He was trying to get Eddie to come back. Eddie was the darling of Europe, the “Dark Angel of Violin”. He was playing for the Rockefeller parties and all those big social affairs in Europe and he made quite a name for himself. This manager decided he thought it would be nice to put him in one of the hotels in Chicago. It never happened before but…
